_comment: Manual corrections applied by scripts/sign-cbom.mjs to ShorSight's raw scan before it is published and signed. 'set' changes fields; each corrected component records what was changed in a 'beyond-shor:correction' property. 'remove' drops a false positive and records it as a 'beyond-shor:removed' metadata property. Fix these in ShorSight itself, then drop the entry.

crypto/aes-256-gcm.reason: AES-256 key search is the reference for NIST category 5, not 1.

set.properties.crypto:rationale: ECDSA over NIST P-256 (sign/verify in the signature and PKI playgrounds); broken by Shor's algorithm.

crypto/ec-p256.reason: Only sign and verify are used (ECDSA), so the primitive is signature, not key-agree.

crypto/ecdsa.reason: False positive: pqc-lagebild/scan/probe.mjs only classifies the key type of a scanned server's certificate (type === 'ec'). The handshake itself runs in Node's TLS stack, which is outside the scope of this inventory.

crypto/ed25519.reason: False positive: pqc-lagebild/scan/probe.mjs only classifies the key type of a scanned server's certificate (type === 'ed25519'), and the Lagebild view only uses the name as a label. The handshake itself runs in Node's TLS stack, which is outside the scope of this inventory.

crypto/ed448.reason: False positive: pqc-lagebild/scan/probe.mjs only classifies the key type of a scanned server's certificate (type === 'ed448'), and the Lagebild view only uses the name as a label. The handshake itself runs in Node's TLS stack, which is outside the scope of this inventory.

crypto/rsa.reason: False positive: pqc-lagebild/scan/probe.mjs only classifies the key type of a scanned server's certificate (type === 'rsa'). The handshake itself runs in Node's TLS stack, which is outside the scope of this inventory.
